name: Algebraic Isomorphism (Minimax Prefix-Suffix Formulation)
description: Replaces the sequential, state-dependent recurrence of the two-machine flow shop with its mathematically equivalent closed-form expression—minimizing the maximum over all split points of the prefix sum of the first metric and the suffix sum of the second metric. This removes all scheduling terminology and sequential dependency cues that trigger Johnson's rule in LLMs, forcing them to either recognize the algebraic equivalence or re-derive the greedy sorting comparator from scratch.
